messages:
maria-g: Hey security — analytics wants a permanent read role on the SIEM ingest index for cross-team dashboards. asking for scope: tenant=all, fields=redacted (PII masked), retention=90d. Can we do a scoped role or do we need a proxy/export flow?
alex-k: @maria-g thanks. high-level Qs: 1) why tenant=all? which dashboards need full tenancy? 2) do they need raw events or only parsed/normalized fields? 3) compliance: 90d is fine but need reviewed by privacy.
jordan: if this is for retrospective vuln triage we should allow timeboxed elevated access vs permanent read. permanent roles + all tenants feels risky. :eyes:
maria-g: analytics says they need cross-tenant correlation to spot platform-wide regressions (e.g., multi-tenant auth failures). they proposed row-level filters to mask tenant identifiers in the view.
sam: technically we can create a read-only view in SIEM with masking transforms. easier than giving raw index access. we can also route through a service account with CMK-unwrapped snapshots for analytic workloads.
lee: implementation note: masking can be done at ingest or on-read. on-read is simpler but still exposes sensitive fields in queries unless we enforce column-level ACLs. on-ingest requires pipeline changes and reindexing older data if they want historical 90d.
alex-k: We Need an audit trail for any role grant. propose: create a short-lived delegation flow initially (30d), require ticket (Jira ID) and approval from privacy + infra, and log grant in audit-log with CMK key-id. Also require justification stored in ticket.
maria-g: sounds reasonable. analytics prefers permanent if possible. can we automate renewals with attestation every 30d?
jordan: automated renewals ok if attestation includes: project owners + security + evidence of use. if attestation missing, auto-revoke. we should also limit query rates and disable exports to external sinks.
lee: technical snippet for a role we can create:
```json
{
  "role_name": "siem_analytics_read",
  "scopes": ["siem-parsed-view"],
  "allowed_fields": ["timestamp","event_type","normalized_actor"],
  "disallowed_fields": ["raw_payload","user_email","ip_full"],
  "max_query_rate": "10qps",
  "retention_days": "90"
}
```
sam: note on KMS: if analytics needs periodic bulk decrypts (e.g., for historical joins) we cannot allow them to unwrap with CMK directly. we should provide ephemeral snapshots where KMS unwrap happens in a controlled service account and data is re-encrypted to a analytics-only CMK. every unwrap must be logged.
sec-bot: Audit: role_change by maria-g queued. ticket: SEC-6821 required for approvals. Please attach privacy approval before 1765433600.
alex-k: next steps: 1) maria: ask analytics to create a short writeup (purpose + owners + expected queries) 2) create temporary role siem_analytics_read_30d 3) infra: provision parsed view + masking pipeline for future ingest 4) privacy: review retention and masking 5) security: enable query rate limits and export-blocking.
maria-g: I'll get the writeup today and link SEC-6821. can infra estimate reindex effort for 90d historical masking?
sam: quick estimate: reindex 90d across ~3 shards ~ ~10M events/day = ~900M events. with current cluster we can do a rolling reindex over 48h with throttle; cost ~1.2x current CPU burn and temporary storage bump. put up a spike run in staging first.
lee: if we do on-read masking instead we avoid reindex but lose historical guarantees for derived datasets. tradeoffs documented.
jordan: also add incident access flow: during incidents, oncall can request emergency unmasking for a 4h window; require two-person approval (oncall + security lead) and log unmask action to immutable audit bucket.
alex-k: agreed. add automation: emergency_unmask action requires ticket, 2 approvals, and generates a signed S3 presigned URL to encrypted snapshot for forensic team. the unwrap happens server-side and writes to a WORM bucket.
maria-g: OK moving forward with temp 30d role and writeup. will tag @privacy and link SEC-6821. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
